questions.topic: PrepLadder · 24.Recommended Dietary Allowances and Nutritional Health Programmes
questions.stem: Pick out the true statements regarding reference for Indian man and woman in the latest NIN-RDA guidelines. The age group considered is 19-39 for both men and women. According to the guidelines Ideal weight of an Indian man is 60 kgs and woman is 50kgs The guideline requires a person to rest for at least 8 hours daily. The guideline promotes not more than 10 hours of intense work every day. At Least 2 hours of recreational activities are mandated. The ideal BMI for men and women is 20-21 kg/m².
